# GP Stakes News Mid-Year Buyside Report: Observations from the First Half of the Year


ORIX USA’s GP Solutions team was recently featured in the GP Stakes News 2026 Mid-Year Buyside Report. In our piece, “Observations from the First Half of the Year”, we dive into the structural trends that have increased the capital demands on GPs in the first half of 2026, the dynamics we expect to see in H2, and ORIX USA’s solutions.


You can find our contribution on page 25 of the report below.


[Read More](https://gpstakesnews.com/p/the-2026-gp-stakes-news-mid-year-buyside-report)


This report requires a subscription to GP Stakes News.
